name: soniox
description: Convert text to speech and transcribe audio using Soniox.

default_voice.description: Soniox voice name or ID for text-to-speech when the caller does not specify one.

default_language.description: ISO language code for text-to-speech when the caller does not specify one.

language_hints.description: Comma-separated language hints for speech-to-text, for example el,en.

region.description: Soniox region. One of: us, eu, jp, in.
